text: Upstream boundary is now available: bbuchsbaum/neuroim2 commit 77b1ddb41a30d251e7751dee84bc81eb93efa07f (Add index-only searchlight geometry), on origin/master for neuroim2 0.19.0, exports searchlight_indices(mask, radius, nonzero = TRUE). It returns deterministic 1-based full-volume index lists with center_indices and space metadata, respects anisotropic geometry and mask filtering, constructs no ROI or coordinate objects, and does not inspect or mutate future::plan(). effectgeom should consume this API as its searchlight-geometry provider and compile the returned neighborhoods into canonical sparse frame rows rather than reimplementing neighborhood enumeration. Until 0.19.0 is released and available through normal dependency channels, integration evidence must identify or pin commit 77b1ddb.
